summary: Executed targeted backend+frontend regression for Buddy/Progress/You customization and theme updates using public preview URL. Backend pytest suite passed 10/10. Frontend critical flows mostly pass (water add/undo restore, advice popup behavior, horizontal history tap, subscription layout on 390/320, Edit Goal route/cancel/save return, shortcut removals).

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate testID `goal-card` rendered in DOM (Playwright strict-mode resolved 2 matches), causing ambiguous automation targeting.

integration_issues.issue: Selected cosmetic state is not reliably exposed via web accessibility attributes (`aria-selected` came back null), so UI-level persistence assertions are partially blocked even though backend equip persistence passed.

Web switch control for `dark-mode-toggle` does not provide a stable checked-state signal for automation (`is_checked` unsupported, aria checked inconsistent), reducing deterministic persistence assertions. Visual propagation across routes worked.

action_items: Make `goal-card` testID unique on Profile screen to avoid duplicate element resolution.
Expose deterministic selected state for cosmetic tiles on web (e.g., stable `data-selected` or aria semantics) to support reliable UI persistence checks.
Expose deterministic checked state for `dark-mode-toggle` (web) to enable robust automation verification.
Main agent should quickly self-verify demo profile baseline values (goal/age/targets) if strict restoration parity is required. Demo equipment was restored to defaults after testing.
critical_code_review_comments: UI testability gap: some interactive stateful controls rely on visual style only without machine-readable state hooks, making regression checks brittle.
Given broad cross-screen theme requirements, add explicit testIDs/attributes for theme state and selected cosmetic state to reduce false negatives in automation.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core requested flows passed; two state-verification checks partially blocked by testability attributes)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users during backend pytest via signup fixture; each cleaned up with DELETE /api/me. Demo account cosmetics temporarily changed during UI test and then restored to defaults via /app/scripts/restore_demo_equipment.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for API regression. UI automation should treat dark-mode and cosmetic selection state as partially non-deterministic unless additional state attributes are added.
rca_of_issue: No backend functional failures in this iteration. Primary blockers were frontend state observability (duplicate/ambiguous testID and missing deterministic selected/checked attributes), not API correctness.
